_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run.

projects.description: Multi-agent options trading system. Scout, Quant, Risk Engine and CIO agents hand off decisions through 12 deterministic risk gates with a SHA-256 audit trail.
A RAG assistant over 27 UAE government documents. Sub-second, citation-grounded answers via ChromaDB and Groq's Llama 3.1, served through FastAPI.
A computer vision platform combining five CV techniques: YOLOv8 running at 10+ FPS alongside SegFormer segmentation, wrapped in FastAPI and Streamlit.
An autonomous heat-safety agent that estimates WBGT and rethinks outdoor work schedules to cut heat-related costs.
